7: ThreadPool::ThreadPool(size_t worker_count) : stop(false) {

10:     }
11:     for (size_t i = 0; i < worker_count; i++) {
12:         this->workers.emplace_back(
13:             // Sub Thread Waiting for Task
14:             [this] {
15:                 while (true) {
16:                     std::function<void()> task;
17:                     {
18:                         std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(this->queue_mutex);
19:                         this->condition.wait(lock, [this] {
20:                             return this->stop || !this->tasks.empty();
21:                         });
22:                         if (this->stop && this->tasks.empty()) {
23:                             return;
24:                         }
25:                         task = std::move(tasks.front());
26:                         this->tasks.pop();
27:                     }
28:                     task();
29:                 }
30:             });
31:     }
32: }

36:         std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->queue_mutex);

41:

18: class ThreadPool : MoveOnly {
19:    private:
20:     std::vector<std::thread> workers;
21:     std::queue<std::function<void()>> tasks;
22:     std::mutex queue_mutex;
23:     std::condition_variable condition;
24:     bool stop;
25: 
26:    public:
27:     explicit ThreadPool(size_t worker_count);
28:     ~ThreadPool();
29: 
30:     template <typename Fn>
31:     auto submit(Fn&& fn) -> Result<std::future<std::invoke_result_t<Fn>>> {
32:         // get return type of Fn
33:         using ReturnType = std::invoke_result_t<Fn>;
34: 
35:         auto task = std::make_shared<std::packaged_task<ReturnType()>>(
36:             std::forward<Fn>(fn));
37: 
38:         std::future<ReturnType> res = task->get_future();
39: 
40:         {
41:             std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->queue_mutex);
42:             if (this->stop) {
43:                 return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::ThreadPoolStop));
44:             }
45:             this->tasks.emplace([task] { (*task)(); });
46:         }
47:         condition.notify_one();
48:         return res;
49:     }

37: Result<std::string> Connection::read_until(const std::string& delimiter,
38:                                            const size_t max_buffer_size) {
39:     while (true) {
40:         size_t pos = read_buffer.find(delimiter);
41:         if (pos != std::string::npos) {
42:             size_t extract_len = pos + delimiter.size();
43:             std::string result = read_buffer.substr(0, extract_len);
44:             read_buffer.erase(0, extract_len);
45:             return result;
46:         }
47: 
48:         std::array<char, READ_CHUNK_SIZE> temp_buf;
49:         ssize_t bytes_read = ::read(fd, temp_buf.data(), sizeof(temp_buf));
50: 
51:         if (bytes_read < 0) {
52:             if (errno == EINTR) {
53:                 continue;
54:             }
55:             return std::unexpected(
56:                 make_err(ErrCode::ConnectionReadFailed, errno));
57:         }
58: 
59:         if (bytes_read == 0) {
60:             return std::unexpected(
61:                 make_err(ErrCode::ConnectionClosedBeforeDelimiter));
62:         }
63: 
64:         read_buffer.append(temp_buf.data(), bytes_read);
65: 
66:         if (read_buffer.size() > max_buffer_size) {
67:             return std::unexpected(make_err(ErrCode::RequestHeaderTooLarge));
68:         }
69:     }
70: }

16:

18:         case '!':
19:         case '#':
20:         case '$':

22:         case '&':
23:         case '\'':
24:         case '*':
25:         case '+':
26:         case '-':

32:         case '~':
33:             return true;
34:         default:
35:             return false;
36:     }
37: }

39: bool is_valid_header_value(std::string_view value) {
40:     for (unsigned char c : value) {
41:         if (c != '\t' && (c < 0x20 || c == 0x7f)) {
42:             return false;
43:         }
44:     }
45: 
46:     return true;
47: }
48: }  // namespace

50: std::string trim(std::string_view s) {
51:     while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.front()))) {
52:         s.remove_prefix(1);
53:     }
54:     while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.back()))) {
55:         s.remove_suffix(1);
56:     }
57:     return std::string(s);
58: }
59: 
60: std::string lower(std::string_view s) {
61:     std::string tmp{ s };
62:     for (char& c : tmp) {
63:         c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
64:     }
65:     return tmp;
66: }

69:     if (token.empty()) {
70:         return false;
71:     }
72: 
73:     for (unsigned char c : token) {
74:         if (!is_http_token_char(c)) {
75:             return false;
76:         }
77:     }
78: 
79:     return true;
80: }
